meta.task: a + b = c, a,b in [0,99], operands as 100 opaque tokens, sum as 3 digit tokens
meta.model: MLP: shared embedding(100,d_embed) for a and b -> concat -> ReLU(d_hidden) -> ReLU(d_hidden) -> 3x10 logits
meta.optimizer: AdamW (decoupled weight decay on all params), full batch

row_fields.test_exact_carry/nocarry: test exact-match split by whether the units digits carry
